text.ms:
1. Mana-mana kenderaan yang membawa Yang di-Pertuan Agong atau

Raja Permaisuri Agong, Raja-Raja atau Permaisuri-Permaisuri Baginda,

Yang di-Pertua Negeri bagi Negeri-Negeri Melaka, Pulau Pinang, Sabah dan

Sarawak atau isteri-isteri mereka, Dato'-Dato' Undang Negeri Sembilan atau

Tengku Besar Tampin atau isteri-isteri mereka, Tengku Mahkota atau Raja Muda

mana-mana Negeri atau isteri-isteri mereka, Raja Di-Hilir Perak atau isterinya,

atau mana-mana pembesar asing yang datang melawat.

2. Mana-mana kenderaan Kerajaan yang membawa Perdana Menteri atau

Timbalan Perdana Menteri.

3. Semua kenderaan tentera yang dimiliki oleh Kerajaan atau mana-mana angkatan

pelawat yang ditafsirkan dalam Akta Angkatan Pelawat 1960 [Akta 432].

4. Semua kenderaan Kerajaan yang digunakan semata-mata untuk tugas ambulans,

tugas melawan kebakaran, tugas polis atau tugas menyelamat termasuk

kenderaan pasukan penyelamat Jabatan Pertahanan Awam dan kenderaan Jabatan

Penjara semasa menjalankan tugas mengiringi banduan.

5. Semua kenderaan yang bukan kenderaan Kerajaan yang digunakan semata-mata

untuk tugas ambulans, tugas melawan kebakaran dan tugas menyelamat.

6. Semua motosikal beroda tiga atau beroda empat yang digunakan oleh

mana-mana orang cacat.
7. Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan dua roda.

8. Mana-mana kenderaan yang digunakan untuk tujuan pekerjaan atau perniagaan

di Kompleks Bebas Cukai Bukit Kayu Hitam dan untuk tujuan pekerjaan

di Kelab Golf Black Forest, Bukit Kayu Hitam, mana-mana kenderaan persendirian

mana-mana anggota angkatan tentera dan Polis Diraja Malaysia dan mana-mana

kenderaan persendirian pegawai dan kakitangan Jabatan Kastam Diraja Malaysia,

Jabatan Imigresen Malaysia, Jabatan Perkhidmatan Kuarantin dan Pemeriksaan

Malaysia dan Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan yang digunakan dalam masa

menjalankan kewajipannya di Kompleks Bebas Cukai Bukit Kayu Hitam, yang telah

dikeluarkan bagi kenderaan itu pelekat elektronik oleh Menteri bagi maksud

pengecualian daripada pembayaran tol.".

Dibuat 27 Oktober 2017

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/1 Jld.18; PN(PU2)426/LXIV]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(BUKIT KAYU HITAM-JITRA HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the

Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Bukit Kayu Hitam-Jitra Highway) (Amendment) Order 2017.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2017.

Substitution of paragraph 3

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Bukit Kayu

Hitam-Jitra Highway) Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 16/1989], which is referred to as the "principal

Order" in this Order, is amended by substituting for paragraph 3 the following paragraph:

"3. A driver of a vehicle shall, before passing

through the Bukit Kayu Hitam Toll Plaza situated at

coordinates N 720589.172, E 270981.835 of the Rectified

Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid as

shown on the map in the Second Schedule, pay the payable

tol electronically with electronic card, electronic device

with electronic card, electronic sticker or with any other

means, as approved by the Minister for the purpose of

payment of tolls.

Payment of

toll".

Substitution of paragraph 4

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for paragraph 4 the following

paragraph:

"4. (1) Subject to subparagraph (2), the vehicles

specified in the Third Schedule are exempted from

payment of toll.

 (2) The vehicles referred to in paragraph 8 of

the Third Schedule is exempted from payment of toll

until 30 April 2018.

Exemption

from

payment of

toll".

Substitution of Second Schedule

4. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the Second Schedule the

following Schedule:

.".

"SECOND SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 2]

MAP OF BUKIT KAYU HITAM–JITRA HIGHWAY

Substitution of Third Schedule

5. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the Third Schedule the following

Schedule:

"THIRD SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 4]

EXEMPTED VEHICLES

1. Any vehicles carrying the Yang di-Pertuan Agong or the Raja Permaisuri Agong,

The Rulers or their consorts, the Yang di-Pertua Negeri of the States of Malacca,

Penang, Sabah and Sarawak or their wives, Dato'-Dato' Undang Negeri Sembilan or

the Tengku Besar Tampin or their wives, the Tengku Mahkota or the Raja Muda of

any State or their wives, the Raja Di-Hilir of Perak or his wife, or any visiting

foreign dignitary.

2. Any Government vehicle carrying the Prime Minister or the Deputy Prime

Minister.

3. All military vehicles belonging to the Government or to any visiting force as

defined in the Visiting Forces Act 1960 [Act 432].

4. All Government vehicles solely engaged in ambulance duties, fire fighting, police

duties or rescue duties inclusive of rescue team vehicles from the Civil Defence

Department and vehicles of the Prison Department whilst on prisoner's escort

duties.

5. All vehicles not being Government vehicles solely engaged in ambulance duties,

fire fighting and rescue duties.

6. All three-wheeled or four-wheeled motorcycles used by any handicapped person.

7. Vehicles having two axles and two wheels.

8. Any vehicle used for work or business at the Kompleks Bebas Cukai Bukit Kayu

Hitam and for work at the Black Forest Golf Club, Bukit Kayu Hitam, any private

vehicle of any member of the armed forces and the Royal Malaysia Police and any

private vehicle of any officer and staff of the Royal Malaysian Customs

Department, Immigration Department of Malaysia, Malaysian Quarantine and

Inspection Services and Road Transport Department used in the course of his

duties at the Kompleks Bebas Cukai Bukit Kayu Hitam, that has been issued with

electronic sticker by the Minister for the purpose of exemption from payment of

toll.".

Made 27 October 2017

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/1 Jld.18; PN(PU2)426/LXIV]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Minister of Works
